finite_scope: 5-bit four-state data, binary clocks, fixed independent structures; no all-parameter/all-clock proof

cases.name: scalar_internal_single_comb_writer
packed_internal_single_clock_writer
cases.candidate: module TopModule(input clk,input [4:0] a,output [4:0] out); wire [4:0] bucket; always @(posedge clk) begin bucket <= a; end assign out=bucket; endmodule

cases.name: two_distinct_internal_procedures
cases.candidate: module TopModule(input clk,input a,output out); wire left; wire right; always @(posedge clk) begin left<=a; end always @(negedge clk) begin right<=a; end assign out=clk ? left:right; endmodule

nested_case_and_if_are_not_instances
